name: JUNO
summary: Large liquid-scintillator neutrino observatory primarily studying oscillations, with collaboration sensitivity studies for neutrinos from MeV dark-matter annihilation.
detection_principle: Low-energy electron antineutrinos interact by inverse beta decay in liquid scintillator. Prompt positron and delayed neutron signals, pulse shapes and muon vetoes suppress backgrounds.

results.summary: Published forecast sensitivity to MeV dark-matter annihilation into antineutrinos in the Galactic halo; a simulated expectation.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
